title: refactor(orders): split the fulfilment service
body:
`FulfilmentService` had grown to do picking and shipping in one class, and every test of either had to stand up both. Splits it into `PickingService` and `ShippingService`, with the old class kept as a thin composition so no caller changes in this PR.

No behaviour change intended. Follow-up will move callers onto the two services directly and delete the wrapper.
